payload.comment: Ingestion stage evidence is internally consistent and passes all deterministic checks. (2) Split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match the official PathMNIST distribution exactly; subsampled=false confirms full dataset. (3) n_channels=3 (RGB) and n_classes=9 are consistent with the standard 28×28 RGB MedMNIST PathMNIST distribution and the 9 listed tissue-class labels. (4) Deterministic findings list is empty — no hard failures. (5) Run manifest records seed=72, deterministic_torch=true, and a pinned package set (torch 2.14.0+cu126, lightning 2.6.5, medmnist 3.0.2, numpy 2.4.6). The test_domain_note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K cross-center origin) is informational and does not alter the ingestion contract. No deterministic findings justify stop or revise. Proceed to next stage.
